_about: Settings for Dallas's Routes page (engine/routes/: build.py, page.html), at /dallas/routes/: pick a stop or DART rail platform near you, see where each DART bus and light rail line from it goes. The light rail lines come from raw/surface/rapid_*.json (surface.json 'rapid', found by name with 'rapidMatch'), their platforms in order; Silver Line and TRE stations count as connections too. DART's real-time data isn't open without a key, so the page shows scheduled departures.

page.title: Where does this line or route go?
page.description: Find the DART bus stops and light rail platforms nearest you in Dallas and see where each route goes, with the next scheduled departures: the ZIP codes it passes through, the main streets it runs along, its rail connections and the landmarks on the way.
page.lede: Find the stops and stations near you, then pick a bus or DART rail line to see where it goes: the ZIP codes, main streets, connections and landmarks along the way.
page.outside: That spot is outside the City of Dallas. Try an address in the city.
page.noMatch: No match in Dallas for “{q}”. Try the full street address, like “1500 Marilla St”.
page.noStops: No stops or stations within {r} of that spot.
page.credits: Routes, stops and timetable: DART GTFS · ZIP codes: U.S. Census Bureau · Streets: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) · Times are scheduled
page.connectWith: DART rail, the Silver Line and the TRE
page.legendKnown: Deep Ellum: the names people use

badges._about: Route badge colours for apps (the web page takes them from factsheet.css): buses dark blue, express white with a blue outline; light rail lines as plain dots in the line's colour.

_nameRules: OpenStreetMap writes Dallas's streets in full (North Central Expressway, West Davis Street); the page abbreviates as the street signs do.
_overground: page 'overground': DART light rail runs at street level and on elevated track, with one short tunnel (Cityplace).
